title: OneOPIdentity
tagline: An opStack using worldID where we assure that everyone has one wallet address. Also utilizes Hyperlane for L1 => opStack messaging.
description:
In a rapidly evolving digital landscape, the need for a distinct and verifiable online presence has become important. The surge in automated bots and the escalating demand for secure online interactions necessitates the creation of a robust identity infrastructure.  OneOpIdentity is an identity infrastructure service meticulously engineered to provide a distinct digital identity for each internet user and empower democratic voting in a decentralized ecosystem. In addition individuals can also propose their proposals to get a referendum. 

At the core of the project lies the World ID a digital identity framework offering clear proof of one's authenticity and individuality. Through the integration of World ID, OneOpIdentity generates cryptographic proof of one's genuine existence, effectively safeguarding the online realm against impersonation and falsification. Each participant is endowed with a unique digital fingerprint, a testament to their status as a unique entity within the digital domain. The project leverages the seamless data transmission capabilities of Hyperlane to transcend the boundaries of Layer 1 (L1) and Layer 2 (L2) networks. Furthermore, OP Stack Hack technology forms a robust defense against fraudulent access. It verifies individuals and ensures that its services remain accessible exclusively to verified entities. OneOpIdentity democratizes digital access, transforming interactions with decentralized applications.
how_its_made:
Democratic voting is the heart of this project, where we have implemented a decentralized and fair decision-making process. The protocol also empowers people to propose ideas or initiatives. These proposals are subjected to a democratic voting mechanism where all participants can cast their votes. For a proposal to pass, it needs to secure a majority of votes from the participants. This ensures that decisions are made collectively and reflect the preferences of the majority. The fact that every individual within the network has the right to submit a proposal promotes inclusivity and allows for a diverse range of ideas to be considered. To ensure efficiency and timely decision-making, there is also a specific time slot allocated for the voting process of each proposal. 

Hack OP Stack: We modified the applyTransaction method to ensure that only verified users can send any transactions. This feature allows us to make sure that everyone has one wallet address. Furthermore, it enhances transaction security by effectively preventing unauthorized users from participating in the network. This strengthens the overall integrity of the system.

Worldcoin (WorldID): Verifying the identity of participants is crucial for maintaining the legitimacy of the decentralized network. The project leverages the WorldID On-Chain verification method to establish the validity of wallet addresses and their ownership. This means that only users with verified Worldcoin IDs can engage in the decentralized network, adding an additional layer of trust and security.


Hyperlane: By deploying Hyperlane to the opStack, the project achieves interoperability between different layers of the blockchain (Layer 1 and Layer 2). This enables seamless communication and message transfer between these layers. The deployment of sender and receiver contracts for  (optimismgoerli and opstack) further extends this interoperability, allowing users to engage in cross-layer transactions while ensuring the verification of participants.

In conclusion, the project is a comprehensive implementation of decentralized decision-making, secure transactions, and identity verification. By combining democratic protocols, secure transaction mechanisms, identity verification, and advanced blockchain technologies, the project establishes a robust ecosystem that empowers participants to contribute, vote, and interact within a trusted and efficient decentralized network.
